quests.title: New Body, New Life
quests.description: You have been reborn as a raider. Get used to your new body.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: A Dangerous Galaxy
quests.description: You’ve learned to move, but the Empire needs stronger raiders. Destroy the training turrets.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Cloak & Bullets
quests.description: You destroyed the turrets brilliantly. Now do the same against moving targets: drones.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: The Sonic Matter
quests.description: Sonic matter is the most valuable resource in Neterun. As a raider, you must learn to collect and deliver it to the Human Empire.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Call to Arms
quests.description: You’ve received a distorted signal from Prometheus Station. Homerus cannot provide more details.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Damn Anomalies
quests.description: An Imperial detector has picked up irregular signals. The Empire offers a reward to anyone who finds the cause.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Broken Stuff
quests.description: The Colossus attack damaged Prometheus, causing malfunctions. The Empire needs a raider to restore order.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: The Power You Need
quests.description: Following the Colossus attack, the exit gate from the area seems locked down. Old Joe, the Empire's right-hand man, asks you to reactivate it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Deadly Biology #1
quests.description: The Empire seeks new data to arm its raiders against Neterunian creatures. You may be the one to provide it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Herd Control
quests.description: Hunt down and eliminate a specified number of Zanion across the galaxy to claim a bounty from the Imperials.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Raider’s Business #1
quests.description: Gather sonic matter from the creatures you cross paths with along your route, then beam it over to the Imperials using a transponder.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Dead Stay Quiet
quests.description: The cerebrally active E-Was damaged the Dump, shutting it down. Reactivate it with generators.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Alter Ego
quests.description: The Colossus has breached the cage protecting the Prometheus area. The Imperials are looking for a raider willing to restore it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Attack by Batiki!
quests.description: The Core area is in crisis. Old Joe needs your help.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Recycling Consciousness
quests.description: Old Joe seeks mnemonic data from fallen raiders’ modules to resurrect them.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: The Hunt
quests.description: A raider with an unknown ID is under Batiki threat. Save him.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Entry-Level Souls
quests.description: Old Joe often assigns less skilled raiders to pilot cargo ships into mining areas. Normally harmless, but after the Batiki attack he needs you to escort one of his most important ships.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Fragments of Old Memories
quests.description: You receive a distress call from a raider who seems disoriented and in shock.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Something Precious
quests.description: Mugai Station’s defenses are restored, but the Batiki still hold the Precious Four Stations, vital to raider colonies. Old Joe calls on you to help reclaim them.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Help the Crystal
quests.description: Crystal Station is surrounded by the Batiki elite. Defeat them before reactivation.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Help the Emerald
quests.description: Batiki tech is jamming Emerald Station’s systems. Destroy it for Old Joe.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Help the Opaleum
quests.description: Batiki interferometers surround Opaleum Station. Destroy them.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Help the Sapphirum
quests.description: Batiki stole a generator from Sapphirum Station, preventing its restoration.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Ballad of Thornstone
quests.description: You defended the Precious Four, and your fame is spreading. Now Oran is asking for your help.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Neterunian Mysticism
quests.description: Treasure hunter Lay Off found a strange Neterunian ruin and seeks your help to explore it.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Raider's Blood
quests.description: A distress call reaches you. It comes from a raider named Rod, who left a trail for you to find him.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Raider's Blood
quests.description: A distress call reaches you. It comes from a raider named Rod, who left a trail for you to find him.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Iron’s Way - Join the Iron
quests.description: Haru, leader of the Iron Guild, offers to take you into her ranks. Eliminate the targets she designates and return their IDs to her.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: My Lord, the Gold - Join the Gold
quests.description: Koyash, leader of the Gold Guild, asks you to retrieve two pure gold spheres lost during an Iron Raider attack.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Outpost, the Lost Base
quests.description: Outpost, an old Imperial base, has communication issues. Kathlee Fares asks you to investigate with her.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Ban Krylam, the First Colossus
quests.description: According to a raider legend, slaying the Neterun Colossi offers a way to escape the galaxy. Homerus leads you onto the trail of one of them: Ban Krylam.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Debt of Pain
quests.description: Sun Lori, a renowned bounty hunter, sends a call for help. For someone of her reputation, this is unusual.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Conscience Run
quests.description: Old Joe has learned of other Interferometers scattered through the Core Areas. He asks you to destroy them. Their exact locations are unknown, but scanner signals reveal four sites: near Mugai Station’s speedgate road, inside Crystal Station among the Precious Four, near Cargo Port in the Guild Stands, and at Kaledo Station in the Outpost.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: What Remains of a Colossus
quests.description: Razan rewards you with the Sonic Matter weapon. With it, you can return to the Rehun, break its defenses, and let Homerus analyze it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Ban Xerte, the Second Colossus
quests.description: After Homerus’ analysis, you learn the Colossi may be vulnerable to the poison of Ban Xerte. To confirm, you must reach the Neterunian Tree area and find Ban Xerte.

quests.title: Excess Souls
quests.description: Old Joe has shared the coordinates of one of his wrecks for examination
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Old Mates, Ones Memory
quests.description: Struck by your abilities, Sun Lori challenges you to hunt down a series of targets ahead of rival bounty hunters. Kill the targets and retrieve their memories to prove their deaths.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Enough is Enough
quests.description: The containment field of a Neterunian monument in the area is malfunctioning, causing an anomalous surge of creatures. Repair the system while keeping the local Zanion packs at bay.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Deja Vu
quests.description: The Batiki have exploited an anomalous signal in the Containment Field Generator that hasn't stabilized yet. Track down the anomaly and eliminate it.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Strong Interaction
quests.description: The battery plant Atoms, vital for the Precious Four, is under attack. E-Stand asks you to defend and restore it.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Deadly Biology #2
quests.description: Husks you supplied revealed anomalies in the Zanion population. The Imperials demand more husks and promise good pay.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Deadly Biology #3
quests.description: While studying Marianan husks, Imperials detect anomalies in Zanion breeding in the Core. More husks are required to trace the source.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Deep Cleaning
quests.description: The husk data you provided to the Imperials reveals that the origin of the anomalous Zanion growth is a mutated nest in the Guild Stands area. Purge the nest.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: A Stint in Outpost
quests.description: One of the most peripheral zones of the Central Region, the Outpost Monitoring Sector, has gone offline. Bring its sensor nodes back online.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Once Upon a Massacre
quests.description: In an mining area of Imperial interest, an old defense system has been reactivated. Bring the threat back to safe levels.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Snake Tongs
quests.description: Consulting the Neterunian Oracle, you've discovered that slaying the colossus Ban Hudel will grant you a weapon against the colossus Ban Krylam. Fire sonic matter at old Neterunian technology to lure Ban Hudel into a trap.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: The Armilla
quests.description: The legend was true. Retrieve the Armilla that animated Ban Hudel.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Veiled Neterun
quests.description: Homerus knows of a region containing ancient Neterunian technology that can help you analyze Ban Krylam's Rehun and establish a strategy against it. Reactivate the Neseref and reach the area.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Take The Mask Off
quests.description: You have finally recovered Ban Hudel's Armilla, pulsing with its energy toxin. Now, head to Marianan and kill Ban Krylam.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Legends and Truth
quests.description: Ban Hudel and Ban Krylam's Armillae resonate together, creating a portal that will allow you to safely cross the Alters surrounding the Galaxy of Neterun and escape.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Aluminium for Prometheus Station
quests.description: Deliver a standard lot of aluminium to Prometheus Station
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Aluminium for Mugai Station
quests.description: Deliver a major shipment of aluminium to Mugai Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Gold for Mugai Station
quests.description: Deliver a sizable cache of gold to Mugai Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Zinc Delivery #1
quests.description: Deliver a small amount of zync to Mugai Station
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Crystal for Crystal Station
quests.description: Deliver a standard lot of crystal to Crystal Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Crystal for Marianan Station
quests.description: Deliver a standard lot of crystal to Marianan Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Crystal Delivery #1
quests.description: Deliver a small amount of crystal to Kaledo Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Recondigen for Kaledo Station
quests.description: Deliver a small sample of recondigen to Kaledo Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Radium for Crystal Station
quests.description: Deliver a standard lot of radium to Crystal Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Ionic Coal for Marianan Station
quests.description: Deliver a small sample of ionic coal to Marianan Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Radium Delivery #2
quests.description: Deliver a reasonable amount of radium to Marianan Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Radium Delivery #3
quests.description: Deliver a large shipment of radium to Marianan Station.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Gold for Gold Last Stand
quests.description: Deliver a small sample of gold to Gold Last Stand.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Aluminium for Iron Last Stand
quests.description: Deliver a small sample of aluminium to Iron Last Stand.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: War of the Guilds
quests.description: "After completing Koyash’s mission, you can now enter the Hole, the guilds’ domain. Fight as a Gold Raider in their war.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: War of the Guilds
quests.description: After completing Haru Okabe’s mission, you can now enter the Hole, ruled by the guilds. Fight as an Iron Raider in their war.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Gold Trust
quests.description: The guild war intensifies. Hard Steel, a key Iron Guild station, is your next target. Its conquest would strike a decisive blow.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Strike at the Iron’s Heart
quests.description: Koyash stresses that strategic dominance of the Hole is vital. He asks you to capture Iron Ore Station for Gold.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Rebirth in Gold
quests.description: Koyash insists loyalty to the God of Gold must be proven. Capture Finery Forge Station, and a rich reward awaits.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Iron Trust
quests.description: Haru explains Iron’s goal is to destabilize Gold. To achieve this, she urges you to seize their stations.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Iron Storm
quests.description: The more foes you defeat during Varna Station’s conquest, the more glory you’ll earn with Haru and the Iron Guild.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Natural Enemies
quests.description: Haru argues Heusos Station is crucial to Gold’s power. Conquering it would strip Koyash of a key asset. She orders you to take it and destroy every enemy
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Colossal Hunting
quests.description: There’s no trace of Ban Xerte in the Tree, but the bio-echo of the Rehun seems to be resonating towards one of the Tree’s areas. Homerus suggests you follow the echo in hopes of finding the Colossus.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: The Approval of a Cult
quests.description: The Malaxdon are unwelcoming to raiders from colonies outside the Tree. Yalda has decided that if you want her help, you must first find some of her siblings who got lost during an investigation.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Cultist Souls
quests.description: Outsider, you have saved one of us, and you deserve my attention. I will try to help you and give you the answers you seek.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: The Lexon Schism
quests.description: The neural fragment of the High Lexon contained a memory in the Last Ruins area, possibly related to Tale Shoo. Yalda told us that he was responsible for the schism the Malaxdon suffered because of Ban Xerte itself, and the bounty the Malaxdon placed on his body. By finding Tale, we will find Ban Xerte and his biological remnant.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: The One Who Betrays
quests.description: An ancient Neterunian Lump allowed us to find traces of the Lexon, the raiders who started the Malaxdon schism. The tracks lead us to the Forbidden Ruins, other Neterunian rests now inhabited by creatures and Alters.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: When the Human Empire Fails
quests.description: The Human Empire is constantly searching for resources. From this perspective, the Neterunian Tree may contain several, but not all raiders are willing to face the danger and collect them. But you are different, right? Besides, we pay well.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Finding a Symbiont - Spore Haustor
quests.description: You have collected the first Haustor, a kind of symbiotic material. There are other types in dangerous areas of the Tree. Collect them for me.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Finding a Symbiont - Capsule Haustor
quests.description: You have collected the first Haustor, a kind of symbiotic material. There are other types in dangerous areas of the Tree. Collect them for me.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Finding a Symbiont - Flare Haustor
quests.description: You have collected the first Haustor, a kind of symbiotic material. There are other types in dangerous areas of the Tree. Collect them for me.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Sworn Enemies
quests.description: The Batiki, damned bastards, have built one of their bases here. They must be eliminated. As always.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Bullets Purge
quests.description: Hey, look who's back. You've come a long way to make it this far.... Well, I'm not good at pleasantries. Actually, I hate wasting time, so: you handled the Blaise Adcott deal brilliantly, and now I want you for another hunt. Prey hiding in the far corners of the Tree.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: A Job for the Few
quests.description: My favorite raider! You’re not afraid of the depths of the Tree, you are a true hero. But I don't want to go there, you know? That's why I need your help. I will pay you well, you have my word, my word!
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Once Upon a Time
quests.description: We need your help. I had sent a group of Malaxdon siblings to scout the Eerie Ruins area for evidence of the aggressive creatures invading Our Tree, but they never returned
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: A New Dawn
quests.description: If you get this message, follow the signal.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Rises Again
quests.description: I am helpless. They drag me along. Help me.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Yard Time
quests.description: I thank you for saving me, but my brother Set is still in the hands of the Lexon. Find the area where they are holding him and do to him what you did to me.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Forbidden Experiments
quests.description: Even if you come from outside the Tree, maybe we can trust you. A group of hunter raiders killed some Tree creatures and ran away. We put a bounty on their bodies, and we want to know what they did.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Raider’s Oath
quests.description: Did you think you were the only one who could make it this far? You idiot! You killed me twice, you won't succeed a third time!
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Lexon Troubles
quests.description: The Lexon have moved into areas forbidden to us. They have managed to use destructive alien technology, taking advantage of the attack they made on Equilibrium. We need help to find and disable it.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Galaxy Soul
quests.description: Yes, it's you... It's truly you...
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Loyal Friend
quests.description: The morays affair... wow, you were amazing. I like warriors like you. You had no mercy for those creatures, and maybe you can help me again.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Awaken The Ruins
quests.description: You have arrived at the long-dead Neterunian Ruins, haunted by Alters. To use their hidden technology, you must reactivate them.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Along the Twisted Branches
quests.description: The first Heka is not enough to revive the central structure. Follow the branches leading toward the outer edges of the area to find and reactivate four more Heka.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Heka Tep
quests.description: Shoot sonic matter at the Heka Tep core to reactivate it and defend it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Heka Res
quests.description: Shoot sonic matter at the Heka Res core to reactivate it and defend it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Heka Sha
quests.description: Shoot sonic matter at the Heka Sha core to reactivate it and defend it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Heka Ha
quests.description: Shoot sonic matter at the Heka Ha core to reactivate it and defend it.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Its Fate Lies in the Void
quests.description: All Heka units are synchronized. The energy threshold has been reached. Power surges into the central structure, awakening the Oracle to be consulted on the Rehun.
quests.label: MANDATORY

quests.title: Neterunian Etching
quests.description: Homerus detects a strong energy fluctuation. There might be something out there.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Neterunian Initiation
quests.description: The reactivation of the Heka has restored power to an aging Neterunian initiation facility. Explore it.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Neterunian Archive
quests.description: Homerus has detected an ancient Neterunian archive, which may contain useful information.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Neterunian Pain
quests.description: Homerus detects a strong energy fluctuation. There might be something out there.
quests.label: SECONDARY

quests.title: Snake Tongs
quests.description: Consulting the Neterunian Oracle, you've discovered that slaying the colossus Ban Hudel will grant you a weapon against the colossus Ban Krylam. Fire sonic matter at old Neterunian technology to lure Ban Hudel into a trap.
quests.label: MANDATORY
